target_segments: Absolute lymphocyte count at least 0.5 x 10^9/L without growth factor support in the preceding 14 days.

text_span: Absolute lymphocyte count at least 0.5 x 10^9/L
sub_criteria.rationale: The absolute lymphocyte count threshold is an independently required laboratory eligibility condition.

text_span: without growth factor support in the preceding 14 days
sub_criteria.rationale: Absence of recent growth factor support is an independently required medication/exposure condition with its own time window.
